summary: Reworked Alembic W3 deepMining consumer commit fb6782f13d2fa201edae8a3cd2e8736ce793ccd5. The single daemon job loop now runs runPlanAgent(deepMining) through runPlanSelectionGate before every round, builds that round's moduleDimensionTargets/perDimensionTargets/moduleScope/budget from the current PlanSelection projection, aborts a later-round plan gate failure before the next rescan while recording the existing plan-gate error event, and feeds CoverageLedgerAdvisor planK/planMaxRounds only from optional runtime PlanSelection.scale fields (k|minNewRecipes and maxRounds), leaving them undefined for Core D2 defaults when absent. Normal rescan/coldStart/moduleMining behavior is preserved; no adjacent repository edits.
